scenicChapters.title: Fortlet Lochmühle → Fort site and civil settlement of Arnsburg
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 36 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-watchtowers-wp-1-69-to-1-72-inclu.story: A 278 km round trip from Höhr-Grenzhausen - roughly 4 h 48 in the saddle. It goes by way of Watchtower WP 2/31, Watchtower WP 3/23*, Fortlet Lochmühle and Fort site and civil settlement of Arnsburg. The line favours views over speed.
